paysim.task: contemporaneous transaction classification, NOT future account/ring detection
limitations: Public simulated transactions, not real fraud outcomes
Temporal split alone cannot validate topology
Post-transfer diagnostic deliberately measures outcome-dependent features
Cost parameters are assumptions, not INR losses observed in this unspecified-currency dataset

notes: Simulated transaction classification is not validation of future account or ring detection.
Thresholds were selected on validation data, not the test set.
Intervals are row-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals; account and temporal dependence are not modeled.
The local account simulator recorded no test recall at its selected strict operating point.
The GNN did not earn the selected default path. Full-network AMLworld performance remains unmeasured.
No real financial recovery, customer deployment or direct I4C/NCRP access is claimed.
